sentences.en: Today, the president demands to know why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，总统要求知道为什么美国

sentences.en: should welcome immigrants from, quote, shithole countries.
sentences.zh: 应该欢迎来自所谓“粪坑国家”的移民。

sentences.en: It's alarming lawmakers and threatening an immigration deal.
sentences.zh: 这引起了立法者的警觉，并威胁到了一项移民协议。

sentences.en: But above all, it raises a question about a Central American idea.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，它提出了一个关于中美洲理念的问题。

sentences.en: Who do we let in?
sentences.zh: 我们允许谁进入？

sentences.en: Friday, January 12th.
sentences.zh: 1月12日，星期五。

sentences.en: Julie, what's this meeting in the Oval Office on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，周四在椭圆形办公室举行的会议是怎么回事？

sentences.en: So the president had hosted a meeting earlier in the week and basically called on members of
sentences.zh: 总统在本周早些时候主持了一次会议，基本上像他以前那样呼吁

sentences.en: Congress, as he has before, to come to an agreement, a bipartisan deal, to protect the
sentences.zh: 国会议员达成一项两党协议，以保护

sentences.en: Dreamers, these undocumented immigrants who were brought to the country as children.
sentences.zh: “追梦人”，即那些在童年时期被带到美国的无证移民。

sentences.en: Julie Davis covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: And Dick Durbin, Democrat from Illinois, and Lindsey Graham, Republican from South Carolina, who are the leaders of this effort, both separately called the president and told him,
sentences.zh: 来自伊利诺伊州的民主党人迪克·德宾和来自南卡罗来纳州的共和党人林赛·格雷厄姆，作为这项工作的领导者，分别致电总统并告诉他：

sentences.en: listen, listen, we think we have something.
sentences.zh: 听着，听着，我们认为我们有了一些进展。

sentences.en: And he invited them down to the White House to talk him through it, essentially.
sentences.zh: 于是他邀请他们到白宫，基本上是让他们向他说明情况。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So a Democrat and a Republican, both senators, saying essentially, we think we have a deal for you on DACA that you might like.
sentences.zh: 所以一位民主党人和一位共和党人，两位参议员，基本上是在说：我们认为我们有一个关于“童年抵美者暂缓遣返”（DACA）的协议，你可能会喜欢。

sentences.en: Let's talk it over.
sentences.zh: 我们来商量一下吧。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is not a comprehensive deal, but the president has basically insisted all along
sentences.zh: 这不是一项全面的协议，但总统一直基本上坚持

sentences.en: that any DACA fix have within it certain things that Republicans want to see, and he in particular
sentences.zh: 任何DACA的解决方案都必须包含共和党人希望看到的内容，他特别

sentences.en: wants to see funding for the wall or for border security, an end to what he calls chain migration,
sentences.zh: 希望看到为边境墙或边境安全提供资金，结束他所谓的“链式移民”，

sentences.en: or basically limiting the amount of family that immigrants can bring into the United States after they gain their own legal status.
sentences.zh: 或者说基本上限制移民在获得合法身份后能带入美国的家庭成员数量。

sentences.en: And then ending the diversity visa lottery program, which is a
sentences.zh: 然后是结束多元化签证抽签计划，这是一个

sentences.en: State Department program that allocates about 50,000 visas a year to people from countries who don't send a lot of people otherwise to the United States.
sentences.zh: 国务院项目，每年向那些原本向美国输送移民较少的国家的人分配约5万个签证。

sentences.en: So what's under discussion here are the big issues that would be part of a DACA deal, fixing DACA, border security, ending what the president calls chain migration,
sentences.zh: 所以这里讨论的是DACA协议中涉及的重大议题：修复DACA、边境安全、结束总统所谓的“链式移民”，

sentences.en: or the prioritization of family migration, and the visa lottery program.
sentences.zh: 或者说家庭移民的优先权，以及签证抽签计划。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the senators, one of the reasons they thought they had a good deal here is because they had all four of those elements in their proposal.
sentences.zh: 参议员们认为他们达成了一项好协议的原因之一，就是他们的提案中包含了所有这四个要素。

sentences.en: So what happens when Graham and Durbin get to the White House?
sentences.zh: 那么当格雷厄姆和德宾到达白宫时发生了什么？

sentences.en: So when they get to the White House, they think they're going to have essentially a three-way meeting with the president to walk him through this proposal.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达白宫时，他们以为会与总统进行一场三方会议，向他介绍这个提案。

sentences.en: And they do sit down with the president in the cabinet room.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在内阁会议室与总统坐了下来。

sentences.en: But what happens next is that a door opens and a bunch of Republicans file in.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的事情是，门开了，一群共和党人鱼贯而入。

sentences.en: Some of them are immigration hardliners who have been very skeptical of a DACA fix.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是移民强硬派，他们一直对DACA的解决方案持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Immigration in the country should be founded on a couple of principles.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的移民政策应该建立在几个原则之上。

sentences.en: One, that it is
sentences.zh: 第一，它必须

sentences.en: fair to American workers.
sentences.zh: 对美国工人公平。

sentences.en: One of whom is Bob Goodlatte, the chairman of the House Judiciary Committee, who just released a
sentences.zh: 其中一位是众议院司法委员会主席鲍勃·古德拉特，他刚刚发布了一项

sentences.en: DACA fix bill that was quite a bit to the right of even what the president had laid out, which basically wouldn't give any permanent legal status to the Dreamers.
sentences.zh: DACA解决方案法案，其立场甚至比总统提出的还要保守得多，基本上不会给“追梦人”任何永久合法身份。

sentences.en: It would have them on renewable temporary permits on a continuing basis.
sentences.zh: 它只会让他们持有可续签的临时许可证。

sentences.en: And in addition to all the other conditions, the president has laid out for a DACA deal, it also added more, like cutting off sanctuary cities
sentences.zh: 除了总统为DACA协议设定的所有其他条件外，它还增加了更多要求，比如切断庇护城市

sentences.en: and other measures that are completely anathema to immigration advocacy groups, to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 以及其他对移民倡导团体和民主党人来说完全无法接受的措施。

sentences.en: So it's basically things that would, you know, be poison pills in any potential deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这些基本上就是任何潜在协议中的“毒丸”。

sentences.en: So he's in the room, as is Tom Cotton, who has basically not only advocated against any sort of legal status for undocumented people, but also for cutting legal immigration levels.
sentences.zh: 所以他在房间里，汤姆·科顿也在，他不仅主张反对给予无证人员任何形式的合法身份，还主张削减合法移民水平。

sentences.en: One of the most important in those areas is chain migration, the ability of American citizens and
sentences.zh: 这些领域中最重要的一点是链式移民，即美国公民和

sentences.en: green card holders to bring in not just their spouses and their unmarried minor children, but their parents and their adult children and their siblings and so forth.
sentences.zh: 绿卡持有者不仅能带入配偶和未婚未成年子女，还能带入父母、成年子女、兄弟姐妹等等。

sentences.en: That's the single biggest source of low-skilled and unskilled immigration in this country, the kind of immigration that puts
sentences.zh: 这是这个国家低技能和非技术移民的最大来源，这种移民

sentences.en: downward pressure on the wages of blue-collar Americans.
sentences.zh: 对蓝领美国人的工资造成了下行压力。

sentences.en: And he's made it clear in the past that he might consider a deal that would normalize the dreamers,
sentences.zh: 他过去已经明确表示，他可能会考虑一项使“追梦人”合法化的协议，

sentences.en: but it would have to come at a very high price in terms of the restrictions that he wants to see going forward on future legal immigration.
sentences.zh: 但这将付出极高的代价，即他希望在未来合法移民方面看到的限制。

sentences.en: So presumably the president invited these hardline conservatives from Congress, or we don't really know, but they made their way to the White House somehow.
sentences.zh: 所以大概是总统邀请了这些来自国会的强硬派保守党人，或者我们并不确定，但他们以某种方式来到了白宫。

sentences.en: We don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我们确实不清楚。

sentences.en: One of the aides who was at the meeting was Stephen Miller, who has been very influential at the White House on immigration policy, was very influential in Trump's campaign
sentences.zh: 会议中的一名助手是斯蒂芬·米勒，他在白宫移民政策方面非常有影响力，在特朗普的竞选活动中

sentences.en: on immigration.
sentences.zh: 对移民问题也很有影响力。

sentences.en: And he has done this in the paSt. When the president has strayed into a potential deal or talking publicly about wanting to make a compromise with Chuck and Nancy, Stephen Miller
sentences.zh: 他过去也这样做过。当总统偏离轨道，想要达成潜在协议或公开谈论想与查克和南希妥协时，斯蒂芬·米勒

sentences.en: always finds a way to make sure that the concerns of immigration restrictionists are reinforced.
sentences.zh: 总是能找到办法确保移民限制主义者的担忧得到加强。

sentences.en: And he always has, you know, sort of played that role in the Trump White House of pulling the
sentences.zh: 他一直以来在特朗普白宫中扮演着那种角色，把

sentences.en: president back to and reminding him of these principles that he ran on that are very much
sentences.zh: 总统拉回来，提醒他那些他竞选时所依据的原则，这些原则与

sentences.en: in conflict with the approach that he's seeming to pursue now of trying to find a common ground with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他现在似乎正在追求的试图与民主党人寻找共同点的做法非常冲突。

sentences.en: I feel having the Democrats in with us is absolutely vital because this should be a bipartisan bill.
sentences.zh: 我觉得让民主党人加入我们是绝对必要的，因为这应该是一项两党法案。

sentences.en: This should be a bill of love.
sentences.zh: 这应该是一项充满爱的法案。

sentences.en: Truly, it should be a bill of love.
sentences.zh: 真的，这应该是一项充满爱的法案。

sentences.en: And we can do that.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: So a bunch of senators with various and competing interests on immigration show up at the White
sentences.zh: 所以一群在移民问题上有不同且相互竞争利益的参议员出现在白宫，

sentences.en: House and are suddenly thrown together and are making their case to the president.
sentences.zh: 突然被聚在一起，并向总统陈述他们的理由。

sentences.en: What happens once all these lawmakers are together in one room?
sentences.zh: 当所有这些立法者聚在一个房间里时会发生什么？

sentences.en: So it is a bunch of senators with divergent interests, but the meeting still begins the way that Durbin and Graham thought it would, in that they are basically laying out what the
sentences.zh: 所以这是一群利益分歧的参议员，但会议开始时还是按照德宾和格雷厄姆预想的那样，他们基本上是在陈述

sentences.en: substance of their proposal is.
sentences.zh: 他们提案的内容。

sentences.en: OK, here's what we've got for you.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是我们为你准备的方案。

sentences.en: But instead of doing it just for Trump, they're now doing it for all these other Republicans on his right flank who are sort of
sentences.zh: 但他们现在不是只对特朗普一个人说，而是对所有坐在桌旁、密切关注着如果总统决定支持这个方案，

sentences.en: sitting at the table, listening intently on what it is that they're going to be forced to swallow if the president decides to bless this thing.
sentences.zh: 他们将被迫接受什么内容的右翼共和党人说。

sentences.en: And what's the plan that Durbin and Graham lay out in this room?
sentences.zh: 德宾和格雷厄姆在这个房间里提出的计划是什么？

sentences.en: So it's a plan that they've been talking about to basically protect the DACA recipients to address their parents' situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个他们一直在讨论的计划，基本上是为了保护DACA接收者，并解决他们父母的情况。

sentences.en: It has a lot of elements in it.
sentences.zh: 它包含了很多要素。

sentences.en: But one of the elements is that they're ending the diversity visa lottery program and essentially shifting those visas over to other
sentences.zh: 但其中一个要素是他们要结束多元化签证抽签计划，并基本上将这些签证转移到其他

sentences.en: populations, including some of them going to people who have had temporary protected status in this
sentences.zh: 群体，包括其中一些将发放给那些在该国拥有临时保护身份的人，

sentences.en: country, people from El Salvador, people from Haiti, other folks who have been here because their countries have been in crisis.
sentences.zh: 来自萨尔瓦多的人、来自海地的人，以及其他因为国家陷入危机而一直待在这里的人。

sentences.en: And President Trump has moved over the last several months to end that status.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在过去几个月里已经采取行动结束了这种身份。

sentences.en: So the idea was to shift the diversity lottery visas in part over to those people.
sentences.zh: 所以这个想法是将多元化抽签签证部分转移给这些人。

sentences.en: So they're talking about doing away with this lottery program, which the president has criticized.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在谈论废除这个总统批评过的抽签计划。

sentences.en: Diversity lottery sounds nice.
sentences.zh: 多元化抽签听起来不错。

sentences.en: It's not nice.
sentences.zh: 它并不好。

sentences.en: It's not good.
sentences.zh: 它不好。

sentences.en: It's not good.
sentences.zh: 它不好。

sentences.en: It hasn't been good.
sentences.zh: 它一直都不好。

sentences.en: We've been against it.
sentences.zh: 我们一直反对它。

sentences.en: And has associated with terrorism on a number of occasions and using those visas instead to help
sentences.zh: 并且多次将其与恐怖主义联系起来，而是利用这些签证来帮助

sentences.en: people who are coming specifically from troubled spots around the world, which is what the temporary protected status program does.
sentences.zh: 那些专门来自世界各地动荡地区的人，这正是临时保护身份计划所做的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is the visa reform part of the proposal, and it gets really complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以这是提案中的签证改革部分，而且变得非常复杂。

sentences.en: But the idea was that, you know, a lot of immigration is a numbers game.
sentences.zh: 但这个想法是，你知道，很多移民问题是一场数字游戏。

sentences.en: And if you're going to give up 50,000 visas that are being issued each year, they wanted to make sure that, you know, those visas in turn would
sentences.zh: 如果你要放弃每年发放的5万个签证，他们想确保这些签证反过来

sentences.en: be going to other immigrant populations that needed them.
sentences.zh: 会流向其他需要它们的移民群体。

sentences.en: So Senator Durbin was describing to President
sentences.zh: 所以德宾参议员正在向特朗普总统描述

sentences.en: Trump how this would work, how the visa allocation would shift.
sentences.zh: 这将如何运作，签证分配将如何转移。

sentences.en: And that's where they got into a discussion of specific countries.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们开始讨论具体的国家。

sentences.en: And he began to run down a list of who would be affected and how.
sentences.zh: 他开始列举谁会受到影响以及如何受到影响。

sentences.en: And what are the countries that Durbin mentions to the president as suddenly benefiting if visas are shifted from a diversity lottery over to temporary protected status?
sentences.zh: 德宾向总统提到的那些如果签证从多元化抽签转移到临时保护身份后会突然受益的国家有哪些？

sentences.en: So he mentions El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 他提到了萨尔瓦多。

sentences.en: He mentions Honduras.
sentences.zh: 他提到了洪都拉斯。

sentences.en: And then he gets to Haiti.
sentences.zh: 然后他提到了海地。

sentences.en: And the president stops him and says, why do we want people from Haiti?
sentences.zh: 总统打断他说，我们为什么要海地人？

sentences.en: And then he adds, can we take them out?
sentences.zh: 然后他补充说，我们能把他们赶走吗？

sentences.en: And that kind of fell like a brick in the room.
sentences.zh: 这在房间里就像一块砖头落地一样。

sentences.en: And it seems like many people in there were very taken aback.
sentences.zh: 看起来房间里的许多人都非常吃惊。

sentences.en: Nobody really knew what to say.
sentences.zh: 没人真的知道该说什么。

sentences.en: But Senator Durbin actually continued this explanation of how this would work.
sentences.zh: 但德宾参议员实际上继续解释这将如何运作。

sentences.en: Because again, it's about numbers.
sentences.zh: 因为再说一次，这是关于数字的问题。

sentences.en: It's about specific countries.
sentences.zh: 这是关于具体国家的问题。

sentences.en: And it gets pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 而且变得相当复杂。

sentences.en: And then he went on to explain how people from African nations would be affected a little bit differently, depending on where they were from.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续解释来自非洲国家的人会受到什么不同的影响，取决于他们来自哪里。

sentences.en: And this is when the president seemed to really become frustrated and angry and said, why are we taking these people from shithole countries?
sentences.zh: 就在这时，总统似乎真的变得沮丧和愤怒，说：我们为什么要接收这些来自“粪坑国家”的人？

sentences.en: We should be taking more people from places like Norway.
sentences.zh: 我们应该接收更多来自挪威这样地方的人。

sentences.en: Do we know how the people in the room, these lawmakers, reacted to that statement from the president?
sentences.zh: 我们知道房间里的人，这些立法者，对总统的这番话有什么反应吗？

sentences.en: We don't.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: All of the lawmakers in that room declined to characterize a private conversation.
sentences.zh: 房间里的所有立法者都拒绝评论这次私人谈话。

sentences.en: None of them would comment afterward about what was said.
sentences.zh: 事后他们中没有人评论说了什么。

sentences.en: Senator Durbin did go back to the Hill looking ashen and dejected and say that he was expecting one thing at this meeting and he got something quite different.
sentences.zh: 德宾参议员确实回到了国会山，看起来面色苍白、垂头丧气，说他原本对这次会议有某种期待，结果却完全不同。

sentences.en: But no one would really say on the record what went on in that room.
sentences.zh: 但没有人真的在公开场合说出房间里发生了什么。

sentences.en: My understanding is there was some degree of pushback.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，确实有一定程度的抵制。

sentences.en: There were folks in that room who made it clear that they didn't agree with what the president was saying.
sentences.zh: 房间里有人明确表示他们不同意总统所说的话。

sentences.en: They were just shocked that the president had said what he said and they weren't sure, frankly, where this left the rest of the negotiation, if there even is a negotiation left.
sentences.zh: 他们只是对总统说出那样的话感到震惊，坦率地说，他们不确定这会让其余的谈判处于什么境地，如果谈判还存在的话。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: This strikes me, Julie, as a comment that could either be hugely meaningful in what it says in
sentences.zh: 朱莉，这让我觉得，这番评论要么在这些谈判中意义重大，要么完全没有意义，或者只是总统的一种个人反应。

sentences.en: these negotiations or not at all, or just kind of a personal reaction from the president.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这些评论与特朗普总统之前在闭门会议上关于移民的评论并无不同。

sentences.en: These comments were not unlike comments that President Trump has made before behind closed doors about immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们去年年底报道说，他在2017年6月的一次椭圆形办公室会议上，对发放给世界各国的签证数量感到非常、非常激动和愤怒。

sentences.en: We reported late last year that he was in a meeting in the Oval Office in June of 2017 getting really, really worked up and angry about the number of visas that had been
sentences.zh: 他说有太多的外国人进来了。

sentences.en: issued to countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们从四面八方涌入。

sentences.en: He was saying there's too many foreigners coming in.
sentences.zh: 但他选择特别指出的国家是海地，他说，哦，他们都有艾滋病。

sentences.en: They're coming in from everywhere.
sentences.zh: 还有尼日利亚，他说，好吧，这些人不可能来到这里，看到这一切，然后又回到他们的茅屋里去。

sentences.en: But the countries he chose to single out were Haiti, where he said, oh, they all have AIDS.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这些并不是什么可怕的话。

sentences.en: And Nigeria, where he said, well, there's no way all those people are going to come here, see all of this, and then go back to their huts.
sentences.zh: 它们没有重大的意义。

sentences.en: And to him, these are not horrible things to say.
sentences.zh: 这只是他表达对一个他认为已经崩溃的系统感到沮丧的一种方式。

sentences.en: They don't have huge significance.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到一个能够引入受过教育的人和在经济上能够自给自足的人的移民系统。

sentences.en: It's just a way of registering his frustration with a system he thinks is broken.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到一个能够引入受过教育的人和在经济上能够自给自足的人的移民系统。

sentences.en: And he wants to see an immigration system that brings in educated people and people who are going to be economically self-sufficient.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到一个能够引入受过教育的人和在经济上能够自给自足的人的移民系统。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want any of these people from other places that he considers to be inferior places.
sentences.zh: 而且他并不想要任何来自他认为低劣地方的人。

sentences.en: But what people hear when he says that, and certainly when he uses language like this, is we want wealthy white people,
sentences.zh: 但当他说出这番话，尤其是使用这种语言时，人们听到的是：我们想要富有的白人，

sentences.en: not people from African nations, not people from Haiti, not essentially black people.
sentences.zh: 而不是来自非洲国家的人，不是来自海地的人，本质上就是不要黑人。

sentences.en: So from his perspective, this is just a comment in line with his views that America should have a merit-based immigration system in which only the best people, the most deserving,
sentences.zh: 所以从他的角度来看，这只是符合他观点的一番评论，他认为美国应该实行基于择优的移民制度，只有最优秀、最值得的人，

sentences.en: should be allowed in.
sentences.zh: 才应该被允许进入。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But in this case, it's the language itself that became the story and that became the takeaway.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，正是这种语言本身成了新闻焦点，也成了人们的谈资。

sentences.en: I've never really had a night where it's very hard to cover what's going on in the news without saying stuff that it's really not OK to say on TV.
sentences.zh: 我真的从来没有经历过这样一个夜晚，很难在不使用电视上不宜播出的词汇的情况下，去报道正在发生的新闻。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That you have to actually curse to quote the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 你竟然必须得用脏话来引用美国总统的话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Parents, if you're watching with children, you might want to mute for the next 35 seconds.
sentences.zh: 各位家长，如果您正和孩子一起观看，接下来的35秒您可能需要静音。

sentences.en: Quote, why are we having all these people from bleep countries come here?
sentences.zh: 引用：为什么我们要让所有这些来自烂国家的垃圾人来到这里？

sentences.en: I hope I did that OK.
sentences.zh: 希望我刚才处理得还行。

sentences.en: Republican congresswoman from Utah said the following.
sentences.zh: 来自犹他州的共和党女众议员说了以下这番话。

sentences.en: The president's comments are unkind, divisive, elitist and fly in the face of our nation's values.
sentences.zh: 总统的评论是不友善、分裂、精英主义的，且公然违背了我们国家的价值观。

sentences.en: It's difficult to separate that from this broader question of what is he going to do about immigration in the United States?
sentences.zh: 很难将这一点与他将如何处理美国移民问题这一更广泛的问题分离开来。

sentences.en: It certainly seems to cast a new light on the White House's recent decisions to end temporary protected status from countries like Haiti and just a few days ago from El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 这无疑让白宫最近决定终止海地等国，以及几天前终止萨尔瓦多的临时保护身份（TPS）的决定，蒙上了一层新的阴影。

sentences.en: Temporary protected status is supposed to be ended because a country is doing better.
sentences.zh: 临时保护身份本应在某个国家情况好转时终止。

sentences.en: It no longer needs those protections.
sentences.zh: 它不再需要那些保护了。

sentences.en: But this suggests that maybe the White House is ending those protections because they just don't want those people in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但这表明，白宫终止这些保护措施，可能仅仅是因为他们不希望这些人留在美国。

sentences.en: Well, there is an irony here as well with that, actually, because in ending the temporary
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上这其中也存在一种讽刺，因为在终止萨尔瓦多人的临时

sentences.en: protected status for El Salvadorans, the Department of Homeland Security actually argued that essentially
sentences.zh: 保护身份时，国土安全部实际上辩称，本质上

sentences.en: El Salvador is no longer a shithole, that it's fine there now and it's OK for people to go home.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多不再是一个烂地方了，那里现在很好，人们回家是没问题的。

sentences.en: And so in addition to, as you said, shedding some new light on the reasons that they might want to end
sentences.zh: 所以，正如你所说，除了为他们可能想要终止这些项目的原因提供了一些新的视角外，

sentences.en: these programs, it completely contradicted the stated rationale for ending them.
sentences.zh: 这完全反驳了他们终止这些项目时所陈述的理由。

sentences.en: Just this week, the president was calling for a bipartisan immigration bill, what he called a bill of love.
sentences.zh: 就在本周，总统还在呼吁一项两党移民法案，他称之为“爱之法案”。

sentences.en: This seems to make it difficult for Democrats and maybe some moderate Republicans to participate in a deal when this is somehow part of the foundation of it, right?
sentences.zh: 当这成为协议基础的一部分时，似乎让民主党人，或许还有一些温和派共和党人，很难参与其中，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it was always going to be a delicate negotiation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这本来就是一场微妙的谈判。

sentences.en: There were already Democrats who were very wary of negotiating with Trump on any of these issues.
sentences.zh: 已经有一些民主党人对在任何这些问题上与特朗普谈判持非常谨慎的态度。

sentences.en: And there were always Republicans who were very wary of letting him get to a table with Democrats to talk about this because he does
sentences.zh: 而且也一直有共和党人非常警惕让他与民主党人坐到谈判桌前讨论此事，因为他确实

sentences.en: have a tendency to, in the moment, want to cut a deal.
sentences.zh: 有一种当场就想达成交易的倾向。

sentences.en: This just makes it much harder for both sides.
sentences.zh: 这只会让双方的处境变得更加困难。

sentences.en: So it's going to be a while, I think, before either Republicans or Democrats can come back to the middle and try to hash out something that might work.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，在共和党或民主党能够回到中间立场并试图敲定一些可行方案之前，还需要一段时间。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Julie, you cover the White House, but you also cover immigration.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：朱莉，你负责报道白宫，但也负责报道移民问题。

sentences.en: So what do you make of the impact of what happened at the White House on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何看待周四白宫发生的事情所产生的影响？

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: I think it really continues an interesting conversation about what immigration is about.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：我认为这确实延续了一场关于移民本质的有趣对话。

sentences.en: President Trump has publicly acknowledged that he doesn't think of immigration as give me
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统公开承认，他并不认为移民是“给我

sentences.en: your tired, your poor, that he thinks of immigration as what is going to help American citizens and how we put America firSt. And it's not about helping people.
sentences.zh: 你疲惫、贫穷的人”，他认为移民是“什么能帮助美国公民，以及我们如何将美国放在首位”。这与帮助他人无关。

sentences.en: It's not about expanding the richness of the country and furthering the American ideal.
sentences.zh: 这与扩展国家的丰富性或推进美国理想无关。

sentences.en: It's just about numbers and about how we compete.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是关于数字，以及我们如何竞争。

sentences.en: And it's quite a dissonance because you have members of Congress in both parties saying, you know, this is a misreading of what America is and what immigration means in America.
sentences.zh: 这相当不协调，因为两党的国会议员都在说，你知道，这是对美国是什么以及移民在美国意味着什么的误读。

sentences.en: It's not about, you know, we pick and choose the countries that we like or don't like.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说，我们挑选我们喜欢或不喜欢的国家。

sentences.en: It's not about taking people only from countries that are beautiful and that people don't think of as places that no one wants to go.
sentences.zh: 这也不是说只从那些美丽的、人们认为没人想去的地方以外的国家接收人口。

sentences.en: So ironically, this kind of lowbrow comment has really pointed up a pretty profound change in the conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以讽刺的是，这种低俗的评论确实凸显了对话中一个相当深刻的变化。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Right.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：没错。

sentences.en: So instead of it being about who needs us, immigration, according to President
sentences.zh: 所以，根据特朗普总统的说法，并且似乎通过这一言论得到了印证，移民不再是关于谁需要我们，

sentences.en: Trump, and illustrated, it seems, by this remark, is about who we as a country need.
sentences.zh: 而是关于我们作为一个国家需要谁。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: And also, it's not about what we can do for immigrants and what immigration is doing for us as a country.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：而且，这也不是关于我们能为移民做什么，以及移民能为我们国家做什么。

sentences.en: It's about what immigration is doing to us.
sentences.zh: 而是关于移民对我们做了什么。

sentences.en: And that is really the way that the president sees it.
sentences.zh: 这确实是总统看待它的方式。

sentences.en: It's not as a value add.
sentences.zh: 它不是一种价值增值。

sentences.en: It's what is it going to cost us as a nation to accept these people?
sentences.zh: 而是我们作为一个国家接纳这些人要付出什么代价？

sentences.en: And is the benefit that we're going to get from that worth the tradeoff?
sentences.zh: 我们从中获得的利益是否值得这种权衡？

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Thank you, Julie.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：谢谢你，朱莉。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Gentlemen, sir, it's the balance of this time.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：各位先生，先生，这是这段时间的平衡。

sentences.en: Gentlemen from California.
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚州的先生。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：谢谢你，议长先生。

sentences.en: I yield myself as much time as I may consume.
sentences.zh: 我给自己预留尽可能多的时间。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Gentlemen, you're recognized.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：先生，你有发言权。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: On Thursday, the House voted to extend the NSA's warrantless surveillance program, which permits the government to collect the communications of foreigners
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：周四，众议院投票通过了延长国家安全局（NSA）的无证监视计划，该计划允许政府收集外国人

sentences.en: from companies like Google and AT&T.
sentences.zh: 从谷歌和AT&T等公司发出的通讯信息。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: Today, the FISA
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：今天，《外国情报监视法》（FISA）

sentences.en: Amendments Reauthorization Act seeks to reauthorize the program while making changes to protect privacy interests.
sentences.zh: 修正案重新授权法案旨在重新授权该计划，同时做出修改以保护隐私利益。

sentences.en: I've long advocated for reforms to surveillance authorities to balance the imperatives of national security and counterterrorism with the privacy rights and civil liberties of
sentences.zh: 我长期以来一直主张对监视权力进行改革，以平衡国家安全和反恐的必要性与

sentences.en: Americans.
sentences.zh: 美国人的隐私权和公民自由。

sentences.en: JARED DILLIAN, JR.: The vote rejects a bipartisan push to impose restrictions on the program when Americans' communications are swept up as part of the data collection.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德·迪利安二世：投票否决了一项两党推动的提案，该提案旨在当美国人的通讯在数据收集过程中被一并截获时，对该计划施加限制。

sentences.en: The bill is also expected to pass the Senate, effectively ending a major debate over national security
sentences.zh: 该法案预计也将通过参议院，从而有效地结束一场关于国家安全

sentences.en: and privacy that started after Edward Snowden revealed the extent of the program's data collection four years ago.
sentences.zh: 和隐私的重大辩论，这场辩论始于四年前爱德华·斯诺登揭露该计划的数据收集范围之后。

sentences.en: And the White House says it will now support states that want to force able-bodied adults to work in order to enroll in Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，现在将支持那些希望强制有劳动能力的成年人工作以加入医疗补助计划（Medicaid）的州。

sentences.en: The decision fulfills our long-time conservative vision for the government's biggest health care program for the poor.
sentences.zh: 这一决定实现了我们长期以来对政府最大的穷人医疗保健计划的保守愿景。

sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全黑暗才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？
